name: perl-test-files
description: This tool provides an interface for the Test::Files Perl module to perform assertions on file and directory contents during automated testing. Use when user asks to compare file contents, filter non-deterministic data for testing, verify directory listings, or perform recursive directory comparisons.
overview: The `perl-test-files` skill provides a specialized interface for the `Test::Files` Perl module. It simplifies the process of asserting that files and directories match expected states during automated testing. Instead of manually opening handles and comparing strings, this tool allows for direct comparison of file contents, file sizes, and directory listings. It supports advanced features like content filtering (to ignore timestamps or non-deterministic data) and recursive directory comparisons.
